scope: Source-linked screening of the second 14 user-selected accounts for a broader channeling/mediumship discovery queue. No change to the frozen Bashar–Ra fitted corpus; inclusion never means every upload is channeling or that entity claims are verified.
method: Read accessible official webpages and retained identity records; use explicitly labeled indexed source metadata when direct platform access is unavailable. Search-engine AI summaries, irrelevant name matches, empty pages and blocked page bodies were not treated as verified source content. No alternate YouTube proxy was used.

limitations: Role screening is based on the listed evidence, not complete upload inventories or watched-video review.
Included accounts need per-upload format, speaker and claimed-entity tagging; interview hosts and guests remain separate.
Entity and healing descriptions are publisher claims, not empirical validation.
Direct YouTube access was not refreshed; stable IDs, official website links, retained account audits and indexed metadata have different evidence strength.
Supplied screenshots remain private; the public artifact records only the selected channel list and relevant research decisions.
